articles.title: Tinubu orders security chiefs to rescue abductees, clear bandit camps
articles.summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu has issued a direct order to security agency heads, demanding the rescue of all abducted persons and the complete eradication of every terrorist and bandit camp across the nation. Defence Minister Gen. Christopher Musa confirmed these directives, highlighting a robust national security strategy. This presidential mandate underscores a firm commitment to tackling pervasive insecurity, restoring law and order, and ensuring the safety and stability of Nigeria.
